title: Securities Dealing Policy

tiers.name: TPW People
tiers.description: Each TPW Group director, officer and employee, plus each contractor and consultant whose terms of engagement apply this policy to them. Subject uniformly to the insider trading, Blackout Period, absolute derivatives/short-term/short-selling/hedging bans (clause 10), and margin lending/encumbrance disclosure (clause 11).

tiers.name: Associate
tiers.description: A family member who may influence or be influenced by the TPW Person (spouse, partner, children, step-children, dependants), a company/trust/other entity the TPW Person can control, and entities the TPW Person acts in concert with.

tiers.name: TPW Group directors other than the Chair
tiers.description: Directors other than the Chair; distinguished for Clearance Officer routing (to the Chair) and for the director ASX-notification deadline (close of business on day of dealing).

tiers.name: Chair
tiers.description: The Chair of the Board; distinguished for Clearance Officer routing (to the Chair of the Audit & Risk Committee) and the exceptional-circumstances dual-approval chain.

tiers.name: Company Secretary
tiers.description: The Company Secretary; distinguished for Clearance Officer routing (to the Chair), since the Company Secretary is otherwise the default Clearance Officer for other TPW People.

tiers.name: TPW People other than Directors, Chair and Company Secretary
tiers.description: All other TPW People; distinguished for Clearance Officer routing (to the Company Secretary) and, for Key Management Personnel within this group, an immediate post-dealing notification obligation (clause 9.3).

definitions.hedging_definition: entering into transactions in financial products which operate to limit the economic risk of Security holdings

windows.start_anchor: close of trading on the ASX on 30 June each year (or the last trading day before, if not a trading day)
windows.end_anchor: the earlier of the day following release to ASX of the unaudited full-year results (revenue and EBITDA) or the Preliminary Final Report

windows.start_anchor: close of trading on the ASX on 31 December each year (or the last trading day before, if not a trading day)
windows.end_anchor: the earlier of the day following release to ASX of the unaudited half-year results (revenue and EBITDA) or the Half Year Report

windows.start_anchor: as specified by the Board from time to time
windows.end_anchor: as specified by the Board from time to time

ad_hoc_blackout_authority: The Board may specify any other period as a Blackout Period from time to time (6.1(c)); no confidentiality requirement is stated for these additional periods.

rules.detail: Absolute, unconditional ban on trading derivative products issued over or in respect of TPW Securities, expressed to apply 'notwithstanding any other part of this policy' - it overrides the clearance and exceptional-circumstances mechanisms entirely, with no vesting-state carve-out.
rules.evidence: Notwithstanding any other part of this policy, TPW People must not at any time: (a) trade in derivate products issued over or in respect of TPW Securities

rules.detail: Absolute, unconditional ban on any hedging arrangement limiting the economic risk of holding TPW Securities, again expressed to override the rest of the policy and with no vesting-state distinction.
rules.evidence: Notwithstanding any other part of this policy, TPW People must not at any time: ... (d) enter into any hedging arrangements that limit the TPW Person's economic risk of holding TPW Securities.

rules.detail: Monetisation is not named, but any structure that is a derivative over TPW Securities or that limits economic risk of holding them (e.g. a collar or prepaid forward) falls within the absolute derivatives and hedging bans.
rules.evidence: TPW People must not at any time: (a) trade in derivate products issued over or in respect of TPW Securities ... or (d) enter into any hedging arrangements that limit the TPW Person's economic risk of holding TPW Securities.

rules.detail: Absolute, unconditional ban on short selling, in the same 'notwithstanding' clause as derivatives and hedging.
rules.evidence: engage in the practice of "short selling" TPW Securities

rules.detail: Securities lending is not named anywhere in the policy.
A CFD referencing TPW shares is a 'derivate product issued over or in respect of TPW Securities' and is caught by the absolute derivatives ban.
rules.evidence: TPW People must not at any time: (a) trade in derivate products issued over or in respect of TPW Securities

rules.detail: Unlike derivatives, hedging and short selling, margin lending is not banned outright. Creating a margin loan is itself a 'dealing' requiring prior written clearance under clause 8 and compliance with Blackout Periods, and the arrangement must additionally be disclosed to the Company Secretary as a Security Arrangement.
rules.evidence: Any TPW Person who enters into margin lending arrangements or otherwise encumbers their TPW Securities (Security Arrangements) is required to provide details of those Security Arrangements to the Company Secretary upon entering into, and on any change ... Security Arrangements may be subject to the prohibitions on dealing in TPW Securities contained in this policy.

rules.detail: Creating a security interest or other financial interest over TPW Securities is expressly a 'dealing' requiring prior written clearance under clause 8, and any such Security Arrangement must be disclosed to the Company Secretary (number/kind of Securities, trigger points, lender's unilateral sale rights) on entry and on material change.
rules.evidence: dealing in Securities includes: ... (iv) creating a hedge, security interest, margin loan or other financial interest over or in relation to Securities

rules.detail: The dealing definition's 'security interest, margin loan or other financial interest' language is broad enough to capture a bank loan secured on TPW Securities; such an arrangement is a dealing requiring clearance and Blackout Period compliance, plus mandatory Security Arrangement disclosure.
rules.evidence: The details of the Security Arrangements which must be provided pursuant to clause 11.1, must include the number of and kind of TPW Securities involved, any trigger points, the right of the lender or security holder to sell the TPW Securities unilaterally and any other material details.

rules.detail: Absolute ban on short-term trading, defined as acquisition and disposal within 6 months of each other, in the same 'notwithstanding' clause as derivatives and hedging.
rules.evidence: deal in the TPW Securities on a short-term trading basis (being dealing where the acquisition and disposal of TPW Securities occurs within 6 months of each other)

clearance.tier: TPW Group directors other than the Chair
clearance.post_trade_deadline: close of business on the day of dealing
clearance.evidence: TPW People must obtain prior approval for any intended dealing in TPW Securities from the relevant Clearance Officer. The request for approval must be submitted at least 3 trading days prior to the date of the intended dealing

clearance.approver: Chair of the Audit & Risk Committee
clearance.post_trade_deadline: close of business on the day of dealing
clearance.evidence: in the case of the Chair, the Chair of the Audit & Risk Committee
in the case of the Company Secretary, the Chair

clearance.tier: TPW People other than Directors, Chair and Company Secretary
clearance.post_trade_deadline: immediately (Key Management Personnel); not otherwise specified
clearance.evidence: Key management personnel other than Directors must notify the Company Secretary immediately after acquiring or disposing of a relevant interest in any TPW Securities.

clearance.approver: Clearance Officer and the Chair (or, for the Chair's own dealing, the Chair of the Audit & Risk Committee)
clearance.evidence: Any consent provided by the Clearance Officer under this policy must: (a) be in writing (email is acceptable); and (b) outline the dates of the clearance to deal period (which must be no more than 5 trading days from the date of the provision of any consent).

short_term.basis: acquisition and disposal within 6 months of each other
short_term.evidence: deal in the TPW Securities on a short-term trading basis (being dealing where the acquisition and disposal of TPW Securities occurs within 6 months of each other)

exceptions.evidence: Dealings that result in no effective change to the beneficial interest in the Securities (eg, transfers of Securities already held in a superannuation fund or trust of which the TPW Person is a beneficiary)

Indirect and incidental trading that occurs as a consequence of a TPW Person dealing in Securities issued by a managed investment scheme, listed investment company, exchange-traded fund or similar investment vehicle that is managed by a third party and that happens to hold as part of its portfolio TPW Securities

where a TPW Person is a trustee, trading in Securities by that trust, provided the TPW Person is not a beneficiary of the trust and any decision to trade during a prohibited period is taken by the other trustees or by the investment managers independently of the TPW Person
undertakings to accept, or the acceptance of, a takeover offer

dealing under an offer or invitation made to all or most of the Security holders, such as a rights issue, a security purchase plan, a dividend or distribution reinvestment plan and an equal access buy-back, where the plan that determines the timing and structure of the offer has been approved by the Board.

a disposal of Securities that is the result of a secured lender unilaterally exercising its rights of sale, for example, under a margin lending arrangement in relation to a margin call (or similar) or default by the TPW Person

participation in a TPW employee incentive scheme. However, where TPW Securities granted under a TPW employee incentive scheme cease to be held under the terms of that plan, any dealings in those TPW Securities must only occur in accordance with this policy.

exceptions.approver: Clearance Officer and the Chair (or Chair of the Audit & Risk Committee for the Chair)
exceptions.evidence: financial hardship which cannot be satisfied otherwise than by dealing in TPW Securities

exceptions.approver: Clearance Officer and the Chair (or Chair of the Audit & Risk Committee for the Chair)
exceptions.evidence: a court order directing the dealing in TPW Securities.

financing_disclosure: TPW People: disclose Security Arrangements (margin lending or other encumbrance) to the Company Secretary upon entering into the arrangement and on any non-trivial change; disclosure must include the number and kind of TPW Securities, any trigger points, and the lender's/security holder's right to sell unilaterally.
financing.minimum_shareholding_requirement: Not addressed within this Securities Dealing Policy itself; the covering ASX announcement separately notes a companion Minimum Shareholding Policy for NEDs and Executive Leadership Team members (Minimum Holding equivalent to base fee or base salary), which is not part of this document and does not state whether hedged or encumbered shares are excluded from counting toward it.

exemption_authority: For Blackout Period dealings only (clause 6), a TPW Person not in possession of Price Sensitive Information may deal in exceptional circumstances (financial hardship not satisfiable other than by dealing, or a court order) with prior written clearance from the Clearance Officer and the Chair (or, for the Chair, the Chair of the Audit & Risk Committee); consent is in the decision-maker's absolute discretion, final and binding, and capped at 5 trading days. This exemption route does not extend to the absolute, 'notwithstanding any other part of this policy' bans in clause 10 (derivatives, short-term trading, short selling, hedging) - no exemption authority exists for those at all.

bespoke_clauses.topic: absolute derivatives ban overrides the whole policy
bespoke_clauses.clause: Notwithstanding any other part of this policy, TPW People must not at any time: (a) trade in derivate products issued over or in respect of TPW Securities
bespoke_clauses.why_it_matters: This is a permanent, non-waivable prohibition with no vesting-state carve-out and no exceptional-circumstances or clearance override anywhere in the policy, so a purchased put or written call over TPW shares can never be executed under this policy regardless of timing or approval.

bespoke_clauses.topic: hedging and short selling equally absolute
bespoke_clauses.clause: TPW People must not at any time: ... (c) engage in the practice of "short selling" TPW Securities; or (d) enter into any hedging arrangements that limit the TPW Person's economic risk of holding TPW Securities.
bespoke_clauses.why_it_matters: Even if the derivatives ban were somehow avoided by structuring, the collar would independently be a prohibited hedging arrangement, with the same absolute, non-waivable character.

bespoke_clauses.clause: Any TPW Person who enters into margin lending arrangements or otherwise encumbers their TPW Securities (Security Arrangements) is required to provide details of those Security Arrangements to the Company Secretary upon entering into, and on any change ... occurring to, the Security Arrangements.
bespoke_clauses.why_it_matters: The loan leg of a funded collar is not banned - only gated by ordinary dealing clearance and a disclosure obligation - but this is irrelevant given the derivative legs cannot be entered into at all.

bespoke_clauses.clause: a disposal of Securities that is the result of a secured lender unilaterally exercising its rights of sale, for example, under a margin lending arrangement in relation to a margin call (or similar) or default by the TPW Person
bespoke_clauses.why_it_matters: Confirms a bank's enforcement sale on default or margin call would not itself breach the policy, though this is moot while the collar's option legs remain prohibited outright.

bespoke_clauses.topic: front page test governs all discretionary approvals
bespoke_clauses.clause: approval will not be granted where the dealing would not satisfy the "front page" test
bespoke_clauses.why_it_matters: Any residual clearance-gated activity connected to a bank-structured product would face a qualitative optics screen in addition to the express prohibitions.

summary: A funded collar is not possible under this policy. Clause 10.1 imposes an absolute, 'notwithstanding any other part of this policy' ban on TPW People trading derivative products over TPW Securities, entering hedging arrangements that limit economic risk, or short selling, with no vesting-state carve-out and, critically, no clearance, exceptional-circumstances, or Board exemption route that can override it - the purchased put and written call are permanently prohibited. By contrast, margin lending and other encumbrance of TPW Securities are not banned: they are treated as an ordinary 'dealing' requiring prior written clearance from the relevant Clearance Officer (at least 3 trading days' notice) outside Blackout Periods, plus mandatory disclosure of the Security Arrangement's terms (securities involved, trigger points, and the lender's unilateral sale rights) to the Company Secretary. A secured lender's unilateral enforcement sale on default or margin call is expressly excluded from the policy. However, because the derivative legs cannot be entered into under any circumstances, the comparative permissiveness of the financing side is immaterial - the funded collar structure as a whole cannot be implemented for a TPW director or executive.
